Concept: Sigmoid growth curve equation
Solution: The sigmoid growth curve, also known as the logistic growth model, is represented by the equation dN/dt = rN(K - N/K). The term (K - N)/K represents the environmental resistance that limits population growth.
Final Answer: dN/dt = rN(K - N/K)"
